description: This file defines models, enums, interfaces, and classes related to telemetry data, WebSocket commands, and subscription management for the Thingsboard platform. It includes data structures for attributes, timeseries, alarms, notifications, and WebSocket command handling, as well as classes for managing subscriptions and data updates.

classes.name: SharedTelemetrySubscriber
classes.description: Manages shared subscriptions for telemetry attributes and alarm statuses, allowing multiple components to share a single WebSocket subscription and manage their subscription lifecycle efficiently.

classes.name: TelemetrySubscriber
classes.description: Handles individual WebSocket subscriptions for telemetry data, including attribute data, alarm status, entity data, and counts. Supports creation of subscriptions, handling incoming data, and managing offset adjustments.

classes.name: NotificationSubscriber
classes.description: Manages WebSocket subscriptions for notifications and notification counts, including creation, handling updates, and lifecycle management.

methods.name: createEntityAttributesSubscription
methods.description: Creates a telemetry subscriber for entity attributes or latest telemetry based on the specified entity ID, attribute scope, and keys.

methods.name: createAlarmStatusSubscription
methods.description: Creates a telemetry subscriber for alarm status updates for a specific entity.

methods.name: createEntityFilterLatestSubscription
methods.description: Creates a telemetry subscriber for latest entity data filtered by an entity filter.

methods.name: setTsOffset
methods.description: Sets a timestamp offset for adjusting incoming data timestamps.

methods.name: onData
methods.description: Handles incoming subscription data messages and emits them via observables.

methods.name: attributeData$
methods.description: Returns an observable of attribute data, updating with latest attribute data.

methods.name: createNotificationCountSubscription
methods.description: Creates a notification subscriber for notification count updates.

methods.name: createNotificationsSubscription
methods.description: Creates a notification subscriber for notifications list updates.

methods.name: createMarkAsReadCommand
methods.description: Creates a command to mark specific notifications as read.

methods.name: createMarkAllAsReadCommand
methods.description: Creates a command to mark all notifications as read.
